3510-4288-5929-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
3510-4288-5929-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1856-6249-6495--5.easyPrerequisites: Doom Weaver paired with the persist creature.
1856-6249-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver ability, pairing it with the persist creature.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1856-6249-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1479-2841-6156-7892.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-7892.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

104-440-2275-7426.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
104-440-2275-7426.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and Cleric Class trigger.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

3375-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3375-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Repeat.
2263-5231-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

141-2292-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2292-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

465-3742-4251-4452-7297.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3525-6788-7170.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-6788-7170.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-6788-7170.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

967-2921-3129-3809-7087.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

620-3532-5078-5705.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

1414-2854-4574-6766.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2854-4574-6766.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1669-3234-3293-3967.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-3967.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-3967.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

77-4315-4679-6053.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of Airtight Alibi attached to Yenna, and then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
When the Airtight Alibi token enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Yenna by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Airtight Alibi trigger, untapping Yenna.
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing the Airtight Alibi token.
Repeat.

628-5405-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1580-4871-5334-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2525-3358-5223.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2281-5231-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior, adding {R}.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2079-2105-3204-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2079-2105-3204-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

586-944-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1013-1170-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
1013-1170-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Hypervolt Grasp by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Hypervolt Grasp spell.
Activate Hypervolt Grasp by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1349-2511-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-2511-6012.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

262-1634-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Pemmin's Aura attached to Devilish Valet.
Any amount of
262-1634-3525.description:
Activate Devilish Valet by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, doubling Devilish Valet's power until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Devilish Valet.
Repeat as desired, or as {U} persists.

3522-3846-4340.manaNeeded: {U}, plus an additional {U} if you have three opponents
3522-3846-4340.notablePrerequisites:
Livewire Lash attached to Atemsis.
You have at most three opponents.
If you have three opponents, Atemsis cannot have summoning sickness.
You have at least six cards in hand with different mana values excluding Artful Dodge.
3522-3846-4340.description:
Cast Artful Dodge by paying {U}, targeting Atemsis.
Atemsis triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Atemsis triggers, causing you to reveal your hand, and causing the damaged opponent to lose the game.
Resolve Artful Dodge, causing Atemsis to be unblockable this turn.
If you have one opponent remaining, skip to step 9.
Otherwise, cast Artful Dodge from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {U}, targeting Atemsis.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Resolve Artful Dodge, exiling it.
Deal combat damage to the remaining opponent using Atemsis.
Atemsis triggers, causing you to reveal your hand, and causing the damaged opponent to lose the game.

32-1164-3278-5103.notablePrerequisites:
Narset does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Narset.
You have at least three other cards in exile.
32-1164-3278-5103.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it.
Holding priority, activate Scrabbling Claws by tapping it, causing you to exile Mirror of Fate from your graveyard.
Resolve the Mirror of Fate ability, choosing itself, Temporal Trespass and three to five other cards, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top, ensuring Temporal Trespass and Mirror of Fate are the topmost cards.
Declare Narset as an attacker.
Narset triggers, exiling the top four cards of your library and allowing you to cast them from exile this turn without paying their mana costs.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Temporal Trespass from exile without paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Trespass.
Cast Mirror of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat each turn.

1357-2232-2757-3474.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Forest and a basic Island.
1357-2232-2757-3474.description:
Activate a basic Island and a basic Forest you control by tapping them, adding {G}{U}.
Cast Errant by paying {U}.
Errant enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft twice by tapping the Cat Warrior token and Errant, untapping a basic Forest and a basic Island.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Errant from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

176-997-3000.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-997-3000.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

2556-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Mnemonic Wall.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, adding {B}.
Mnemonic Wall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
